Expand (aswritten_expand with the IRIs you need) before any claim that turns on WHEN or by WHOM something was said, or whether it is still the current framing. Deciding where to go: each mapped area's narration tells you the SPAN of what lives under it; the area index names everything else. Expand a subtree when its narration (or name) shows your subject plausibly lives there — you'll get the trajectory, the variants, and the verbatim witness.
